usageNotes: Destroys a named CephFS filesystem from the cluster node; the operation is blocked and will refuse if any enabled PVE storage entry of type 'cephfs' still references the filesystem — disable or remove those first. Pass remove-storages=true to let Proxmox clean up the pveceph-managed storage configs automatically, and remove-pools=true to also purge the underlying Ceph metadata and data pools; omitting both leaves the pools and any storage entries intact. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task endpoint to confirm completion before treating the filesystem as gone.

examples.summary: Destroy the CephFS named 'cephfs' on node pve1, removing both its storage entries and underlying pools

destructiveReason: Permanently destroys the CephFS filesystem and, if the optional flags are set, deletes the associated Ceph metadata and data pools along with all data stored in them.
tips: Check for active mounts or running VMs using the filesystem before issuing this call — active clients will not be cleanly disconnected.
If remove-pools is false, the orphaned Ceph pools must be deleted manually via the pool destroy endpoint afterward.
Requires Sys.Modify at the root path ('/'); API tokens must have that privilege explicitly granted.
